description: Use to explain structured changes across sessions, rather than only whether a source changed. Requires a real registered watch_id; reuses its URL/rules and fetches the current public source. Returns bounded JSON Pointer or HTML block changes and deterministic significance hints. compare_to is previous(default) or baseline; previous_hash overrides it and must identify compatible retained evidence. json_array_keys explicitly matches unique typed item identities; ambiguity fails instead of falling back. No cache-age option, scheduler or complete semantic proof; truncated/incompatible baselines can fail409 and unavailable history404. Reuse watch IDs and original-operation recovery material; use Check for a cheaper simple signal or a local diff when you already hold both versions. Paid price $0.015 USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Requires an x402-capable MCP payment client and funded native-USDC payer; ordinary MCP returns a payment challenge. Native MPP is optional only when root mpp_payments.enabled: official mppx, org.paymentauth/credential and optional private recovery. Prepaid uses X-Fresh402-API-Key plus params._meta["fresh402/prepaid"] {idempotency_key,tariff_version,max_credits}; inspect the authenticated quote. Never mix billing methods or automatically pay. Persist original proof/input/recovery material before authorizing; recover originals after uncertainty. Optional Circle Gateway requires root circle_gateway.enabled and its GatewayWalletBatched client; preserve pending originals, never mix providers. Protocol details: https://fresh402.com/docs#payments. Signed machine trial: /v3/agent-trial needs an unfunded EOA ownership signature, no CAPTCHA; separate human Web trial: /v2/trial. Shared eligibility/capacity may return429 early. Send only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key and a persisted per-call Idempotency-Key; reuse exact tool/input/key for retained recovery. Exhaustion never authorizes a charge.

inputSchema.description: Compare a required existing watch against previous or baseline (default previous), or use previous_hash to override the mode. Fetches the current source using saved rules; no cache-age option. Truncated or incompatible legacy baselines can return 409; legacy HTML may have text-only fidelity. Unknown fields are rejected.

compare_to.description: Optional comparison mode: 'previous' (default) uses the latest Smart Diff snapshot, falling back to the current registered watch state on the first call. 'baseline' uses the fixed Smart Diff baseline, initially seeded from the earliest retained compatible watch snapshot. previous_hash overrides either mode. 'hash' is a result label, not an accepted input value.

json_array_keys.description: Optional1-4 explicit nonoverlapping JSON array identity rules, JSON only. Omit for existing index comparison. Matches unique typed scalar keys, reports moves separately from content changes; pure reorder is changed:false while source hashes remain order-sensitive. At most2000 combined array items/20000 comparison work units, no fallback for ambiguity. Rules affect this comparison only, not the watch/hash; persist identical input for payment recovery. Example:[{path:'/items',key:'/id'}].

items.description: Explicit JSON array identity rule. Both paths must resolve; missing/duplicate/invalid identities fail422 without index fallback. Source snapshot ordering/hash is retained.

key.description: Nonempty exact RFC6901 pointer within each object item, up to256 characters/64 segments; e.g.'/id' or '/product/sku'. Every key must exist and be a unique nonempty string<=256 characters or safe integer; number1 differs from string'1'.

path.description: Exact RFC6901 pointer to an array on both compared JSON documents, up to256 characters/64 segments. Empty string selects a root array. Example:'/items'; no wildcards or automatic ID guessing.

previous_hash.description: Optional explicit reference hash: 64 hexadecimal characters, case-insensitive, from this same watch's retained Smart Diff snapshot, fixed baseline or retained registration/Check snapshot. Overrides compare_to. Unknown or pruned hashes return 404; recent snapshot history is limited to 20 per store, with the fixed Smart Diff baseline retained separately. Omit for the selected mode.

watch_id.description: Required existing watch ID: 'w_' plus 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, returned by free fresh402_register or POST /v1/register (a URL-based Check can also create it). Reuses the saved public URL and content rules; do not pass url or new rules here. Replace illustrative IDs with a real returned ID before paying.
